catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class expresses one current sample on an instrument.smu with the upstream trigger settings: cap.measure.current.v1 is a read state of a DMM/SMU/sensor and carries no trigger-delay input or measurement-mode setup, while the upstream read function sends ARM:COUN, TRIG:COUN and TRIG:DEL before READ? (keithley2400.py:114-121).

cap.measure.voltage.v1 is a read class for instrument.dmm/instrument.smu/sensor; it has no trigger-delay input and no place for the upstream voltage-mode setup (SOUR:FUNC CURR, SOUR:CURR 0, CONF:VOLT, FORM:ELEM VOLT), so the one-sample action cannot be bound to it without dropping inputs the clone states.

cap.measure.resistance.v1 binds instrument.dmm and sensor only, not instrument.smu; its inputs (channel, four_wire) and output do not carry the upstream trigger delay or the CONF:RES/FORM:ELEM RES setup, so no catalogue class fits this source-measure unit measurement.

No catalogue class expresses the composite safe state of this source-measure unit (source output disabled and both source quantities zeroed); a safe_state=True action must take no input and run during an e-stop, which is the independent stop SAFE-045 requires when the clone documents no physical e-stop.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The upstream clone is a Python 2 module of module-level functions over prologixGPIBUSB and has no class (keithley2400.py:28-39, 44-46); this is a ScpiDriver command map as the card's family and helper say. native names the card's open_connection entry function for traceability only: the SCPI bridge opens the transport, and neither the upstream module nor prologixGPIBUSB is imported. The model-authored package is unreviewed (reviewed_by stays null); no hardware backend was run and no human reviewed or tested it. Covered: the source-voltage setpoint SOUR:VOLT, with an operator_required limit because the clone states only a 5 uV resolution and no range (keithley2400.py:152-156); the output OUTP ON/OFF with OUTP? readback; one-sample current, voltage and resistance measurement actions that use the clone's mode commands and read sequence (lines 64-68, 114-121, 146-148, 160-164), with the 0 through 99 s one-sample interval bound (lines 248-250); the read-only trigger_delay state so a measurement action shows its applied TRIG:DEL; and a safe_state=True action plus e-stop writing OUTP OFF;SOUR:VOLT 0;SOUR:CURR 0. DEVIATION FROM THE UPSTREAM: the current measurement action keeps the source voltage at its setpoint, while the clone's current_mode sets SOUR:VOLT 0 first; the setpoint is the operator-bounded state and the safe state zeroes it. NOT COVERED: multi-sample read arrays (samples > 1 returns the Time and Data lists, lines 139-142), live readings (lines 86-90), and the Prologix adapter setup (GPIB address 24 and clear, lines 74-77); the hardware backend expects a preconfigured raw-SCPI TCP endpoint or VISA resource and never opens the Prologix adapter. The fake is an in-memory stand-in; its identity, states and readings are placeholders, not a recording of an instrument. Risk R3 is set because the source-measure unit can source a voltage and the clone states no maximum; no line of the clone documents an independent hardware e-stop, so the independent stop is the safe_state=True action.
